Message:
staging: comedi: Prefer using BIT macro in various files.

Challenge suggested by coccinelle.

Replace bit shifting on 1 with the BIT(x) macro.
Coccinelle script:

@@
constant c;
@@

-(1 << c)
+BIT(c)
